headline: Colonial Push Shifts Nevish Line as Linn and Stonecradle Flare
war_summary: In the past three hours, Nevish Line saw dramatic shifts as Colonial thrusts chipped away at Warden dominance, pulling the balance to four Warden and three Colonial redoubts with one neutral ruin amidst raging exchanges at Blackcoat Way and Tomb Father. In Linn of Mercy, the Wardens clawed back ground to secure two garrisons where Colonials previously held nearly uncontested sway, with Lathair and Outwich Ranch enduring five further base transitions. Stonecradle flared into sharp contention with six fresh base actions across The Reach and World's End, leaving Wardens clinging to a solitary stronghold against eight Colonial holdings under punishing fire. Weathered Expanse stabilized somewhat after earlier turnover, recording no base transfers in the last two hours despite unrelenting attrition. Callahan's Passage continues to bleed at a staggering clip, devouring over two thousand combined casualties in two hours without yielding a yard of ground, while Marban Hollow's divided front remains locked in quiet suspense.
